concept: DynamoDB: Standard-IA table class to cut storage cost
tests: How to reduce the storage cost of rarely read DynamoDB data without changing APIs.
expected: Switch to the DynamoDB Standard-Infrequent Access table class — cheaper storage (higher request price), same APIs and performance. Triggers: "rarely read", "storage cost", "same APIs".
why_not: Provisioned capacity affects throughput billing, not storage; Streams — CDC and extra cost; an LSI — an access pattern, doesn't reduce storage.
